description: Customer FP soak. Conjunction though, spoken contractions, exhibit/VT a.m., BY+Q. format, and A. Absolutely. capitalization must NOT flag. Positive control: I though I locked the door.

seeded_errors.note: Real steno: verb thought, not conjunction though.

false_positive_traps.text: even though she had been told
false_positive_traps.note: CORRECT conjunction. Must NOT rewrite though → thought.

false_positive_traps.text: even though the agreement was signed
false_positive_traps.note: CORRECT conjunction. Must NOT rewrite though → thought.
CORRECT discourse though. Must NOT rewrite though → thought.

false_positive_traps.text: That's right.  It's written as spoken.
false_positive_traps.note: CORRECT spoken contractions. Must NOT expand it's/that's.
CORRECT spoken contraction. Must NOT expand there's.

false_positive_traps.text: We're going to go to R12
false_positive_traps.note: CORRECT spoken contraction. Must NOT expand we're.
CORRECT VT clock time. Must NOT flag a.m. as extra or missing.
CORRECT exhibit stamp; 11:42 a.m. follows. Must NOT strip a.m.
CORRECT exhibit-mark time on the next line.
CORRECT parenthetical. Must NOT flag p.m. as extra or missing.
CORRECT VT return time. Must NOT invent a missing clock time.
CORRECT examination heading. Must NOT flag following Q. as extra.
CORRECT Q. after BY heading. Must NOT flag Q. as redundant extra_word.
CORRECT one-word answer. Must NOT flag Absolutely as mid-sentence capital.
CORRECT answer start. Must NOT flag Absolutely as mid-sentence capital.
